major_cautions: 1728 abandoned RAC Bunce trading fort is not whole Sierra Leone loss; local Temne and Bullom remained separate sovereign political groups.
1748 private British slaving enterprise is not 1748 British territorial conquest.
1788 Naimbana treaty has extant archive and competing freehold-versus-lease interpretations; no copied modern peninsula polygon.
1792 Nova Scotian movement is free Black migration, not British slaving voyage.
1794 French assault on Freetown and Bunce is not massacre by British soldiers.
1799 company freehold dispute precedes Black Loyalist rising in 1800, never move the uprising to 1799.
